**Change made in `/biapi/src/main/java/xdev/tableexport/export/ReportBuilder.java` (line 369):**
- Before: `textField.getLineBox().getPen().setLineWidth(border.getLineWidth());`
- After: `textField.getLineBox().getPen().setLineWidth((float)border.getLineWidth());`

The simple cast to `float` resolves the type incompatibility.
